notes.title: 1.1.5.4 Major Update - Key Rebinding & CRT Rendering Settings Added
notes.content:
Major Update Announcement

Dear Players of Ninja Ming: Wu,
We are thrilled to announce new features that enhance your gaming experience!

1️⃣ Key Rebinding is Here!
You can now customize your controls to suit your preferences and play your way. Try it out today!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216285/5aecdaad166aea2383edef0b24b6310936c2b0ef.gif[/img]

2️⃣ CRT Rendering Effect Added!
We’ve introduced a retro CRT rendering option that brings nostalgic vibes and a unique visual style!
How to enable: Navigate to "Home - Keyboard & Mouse Binding" or "Home - Gamepad Binding" to turn it on.
- CRT Off
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216285/02659b3d0123671230cece4cf7c2b37c575ba39b.jpg[/img]

- CRT On
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216285/05c41fc3778cc6fc64d72aa5ea35a074039f5f37.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your support and feedback. We will continue to optimize and update the game, so stay tuned!

— The Ninja Ming: Enlightenment Development Team
